name: ZIAA Core Research Vocabulary
description: The Institute's controlled vocabulary for applied-anomalies research. Every prototype, patent, research note, monograph and post-mortem in the archive is indexed against these terms, so that related records can be retrieved by concept rather than by keyword.

terms.name: Electroacoustic feedback
terms.description: The closed loop formed when a transducer's output re-enters its own input path. Treated at ZIAA as an instrument to be tuned rather than a fault to be suppressed.

terms.name: Physical hysteresis
terms.description: Path-dependent response in which a system's output depends on the direction of approach. Used as an expressive, repeatable performance parameter.

terms.name: Boundary-condition instability
terms.description: Runaway or oscillatory behaviour arising at the limits of a system's operating envelope, particularly where acoustic and structural boundaries interact.

terms.name: Self-regulating instrument
terms.description: An instrument that finds and holds its own stable operating regime through negative feedback, without continuous operator correction.

terms.name: Phantom fundamental
terms.description: The percept of a pitch whose fundamental frequency is absent from the spectrum, reconstructed by the auditory system from its harmonics.

terms.name: Spatial masking
terms.description: Reduced audibility of one source caused by the presence and location of another, exploited in multichannel composition and concealment studies.

terms.name: Wave-terrain synthesis
terms.description: Two-dimensional wavetable synthesis in which a trajectory is traced across a surface, producing timbral motion unavailable to one-dimensional wavetables.

terms.name: Resonant material substrate
terms.description: A solid body — resonant wood, mineral lithophone, cast metal — used as the primary sound-producing element rather than as a loudspeaker cabinet.

terms.name: Contact transduction
terms.description: Pickup of structural vibration by direct mechanical coupling, as distinct from airborne acoustic capture by a diaphragm.

terms.name: Discrete analog signal path
terms.description: A synthesis or conditioning chain built from individual components rather than integrated circuits, prized for its auditable behaviour under overload.

terms.name: Transducer calibration
terms.description: The metrology process that establishes a transducer's sensitivity and frequency response to a documented tolerance.

terms.name: High-order ambisonics
terms.description: Spherical-harmonic spatial audio representation above first order, giving tighter localisation at the cost of array size and decoder complexity.

terms.name: Loudspeaker dome geometry
terms.description: A hemispherical or full-sphere loudspeaker array whose geometry determines the achievable decoder and the composer's available spatial vocabulary.

terms.name: Subterranean resonant volume
terms.description: An underground chamber whose low-frequency modal behaviour is used as a fixed acoustic instrument, as at the Salton Basin vault.

terms.name: Architectural reverberation
terms.description: The reverberant signature contributed by a building's structure and finishes, treated as an irreplaceable component of a site-specific work.

terms.name: Site-specific sound installation
terms.description: A work whose meaning depends on the acoustics and social context of its location and cannot be relocated without loss.

terms.name: Autonomous musical agent
terms.description: A software system that makes musical decisions in real time under constraints, without per-event operator input.

terms.name: Procedural scoring
terms.description: Generation of notated or performed musical structure by rule during performance rather than in advance.

terms.name: Neural audio resynthesis
terms.description: Reconstruction of audio through a learned model, as distinct from analysis-resynthesis using an explicit signal model.

terms.name: Latent audio space
terms.description: The continuous internal representation of a generative audio model, navigated directly as a compositional surface.

terms.name: Generative evaluation protocol
terms.description: A stated procedure for judging whether generative output is musically usable, including criteria for recording a negative result.

terms.name: AudioWorklet processor
terms.description: A user-supplied audio processing unit running on the browser's audio thread, requiring allocation-free and lock-free implementation.

terms.name: Low-latency audio pipeline
terms.description: An input-to-output signal path engineered to a stated and measured latency budget, including base latency and output compensation.

terms.name: WebAssembly DSP core
terms.description: A compiled signal-processing module invoked from the audio thread through a shared buffer, avoiding per-block copying.

terms.name: Micro-buffer wavetable interpolation
terms.description: Interpolation technique for reading wavetables at very small block sizes without introducing audible aliasing or discontinuity.

terms.name: Ambisonic convolution
terms.description: Application of spherical-harmonic impulse responses to a multichannel signal, a principal cost centre in real-time spatial rendering.

terms.name: Tactile acoustic floor
terms.description: A transducer-driven walking surface that conveys audio as whole-body vibration and can be played as an interface.

terms.name: Motorised haptic controller
terms.description: A physical control whose position or resistance is driven by the system, creating a bidirectional tactile channel.

terms.name: Microtonal touch surface
terms.description: A continuous playing surface supporting intervals outside twelve-tone equal temperament, with layout legible without sight.

terms.name: Spatial gesture tracking
terms.description: Capture of performer movement in three dimensions for control of spatialised sound, including its drift and calibration problems.

terms.name: Kinetic acoustic actuator
terms.description: A motorised mechanism that physically strikes, bows or excites a resonant body, as in the Institute's percussion automata.

terms.name: Non-contact optical audio extraction
terms.description: Recovery of audio from a grooved carrier by optically scanning its geometry, with no stylus contact and therefore no further wear.

terms.name: Magnetic remanence imaging
terms.description: Reading residual magnetisation from a tape carrier without transport contact, used where the binder has physically failed.

terms.name: Atmospheric VLF listening
terms.description: Long-duration monitoring in the very-low-frequency band for natural and anthropogenic phenomena below the audible range.

terms.name: Infrasound monitoring
terms.description: Continuous capture below roughly 20 Hz, requiring specialised sensors and long integration windows to be interpretable.

terms.name: Hydrophone array
terms.description: A distributed set of underwater microphones used for localisation and long-duration monitoring, as at the sub-glacial station.

terms.name: Soundscape ecology
terms.description: Study of the biological, geophysical and anthropogenic components of an acoustic environment and their interaction.

terms.name: Kinetic percussion automaton
terms.description: A self-playing mechanism that excites percussion bodies, built both as an instrument and as a critique of automation in performance.

terms.name: Multi-head tape transport
terms.description: A transport with several read or write heads at fixed spacings, producing delay structures determined by the machine's geometry.

terms.name: Design fiction
terms.description: The practice of producing artefacts and documents from an imagined future to make a present possibility arguable. Explicitly not a legal or factual claim.

terms.name: Speculative patent disclosure
terms.description: A dossier written in the register of patent literature, documenting an invention as design fiction. Not a legal filing.

terms.name: Prior-art critique
terms.description: The section of a disclosure that states honestly what already exists and how the proposal differs.

terms.name: Anomaly containment protocol
terms.description: The documented procedure invoked when an experimental system enters an uncontrolled state, covering isolation, verification and release.

terms.name: Root-cause analysis
terms.description: The investigation that establishes why an incident occurred, published as a post-mortem so the negative result remains citable.

terms.name: Salvaged component quarantine
terms.description: Isolation of components recovered from a failed system pending assessment, with chain-of-custody recorded in the revision ledger.

terms.name: Clearance tier
terms.description: The Institute's access classification for a record, from 1-ALPHA through 4-DELTA to BLACK-BOX, governing who may consult the full dossier.
